Interesting links of the week:

Strategy:

* https://tante.cc/2026/09/11/power-grab/ - thoughts on Omarchy from @tante@tldr.nettime.org
* https://ai.rud.is/posts/2026-09-04-cyber100-llms-txt-census - @hrbrmstr@mastodon.social's survey of llms.txt
* https://1password.com/files/resources/frontier-models-vulnerability-patches-flawed.pdf - are LLM derived patches any good?
* https://www.vulncheck.com/blog/anthropic-glasswing-receipts - @vulncheck chip in on bug hunting efficacy
* https://securing.dev/posts/advice-for-conference-speakers/ - a great deck from @securingdev for first time speakers
* https://www.nssif.gov.uk/guidance/problem-books - the UK's hard problems

Threats:

* https://ai.rud.is/posts/2026-09-07-weekly-bulletproof-report - a weekly summary of bullet proof hosting updates from @hrbrmstr@mastodon.social
* https://social.bund.de/@bsi/117212729947889443 - @bsi@social.bund.de gives us a rare look inside an attack on a government org
* https://chasersystems.com/blog/the-curious-incidents-with-dns-in-the-sandbox-at-escape-time/ - @new23d looks at how agents are escaping confinement
* https://www.acronis.com/en/tru/posts/patchcord-new-malware-cluster-targets-afghan-telecom-and-south-asian-critical-infrastructure/ - more attacks on telecomms
* https://offseq.com/en/research/unifi-updater-implant/ - a backdoor in UniFi
* https://hunt.io/blog/redis-cryptomining-botnet-3562-servers - Redis being done over again
* https://exatrack.com/publications/equation-group-s-miniloader.html - hello there fellow maths fans
* https://cert.pl/en/posts/2026/09/vulnerabilities-in-mikrotik-routeros-actively-exploited/ - .pl CERT discuss an in the wild bug affecting RouterOS

Detection:

* https://root-security.eu/notebook/git-forensics-process/ - IR for Git repos
* https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/threat-command/memfd-create-linux-fileless-execution - Elastic discuss fileless attack patterns on Linux
* https://potato.id/en/opsec-fail/ - a catalogue of human failure

Bugs:

* https://vuln.freearchive.org/ - an archive of bugs as seen through @gcve@social.circl.lu

Exploitation:

* https://scotthelme.co.uk/no-hacking-required-manchester-airports-group-data-breach/ - @ScottHelme's rundown on the MAG attack from an offense perspective
* https://projectzero.google/2026/09/maccconc-race-condition.html - P0's work on winning races
* https://calif.io/research/weworm - Calif worms WeChat
* https://addisoncrump.info/research/what-the-hell-are-we-doing/ - the maths of fuzzing with @addison@nothing-ever.works

Hard hacks:

* https://affixsec.substack.com/p/the-3-wifi-extender-with-a-backdoor - when every route takes you down a hole
* https://brownfinesecurity.com/blog/introducing-moria-and-mithril - unpack all the things!
* https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.09272v1 - a modern guide to iOS security features

Hardening:

* https://openssf.org/resources/visualizing-secure-mlops-mlsecops-a-practical-guide-for-building-robust-ai-ml-pipeline-security/ - securing MLOps pipelines with @openssf@social.lfx.dev

Data:

* https://marginalia-search.com/ - s search engine with a focus on human content

Cryptography:

* https://infosec.exchange/@badkeys/117236327118031760 - old keys are weak keys says @badkeys

Nerd:

* https://drewdevault.com/weird-guys/ - @sir@cmpwn.com outlines the nerds you might want to avoid
* https://repository.essex.ac.uk/43577/ - Elite paper 1 from @markmoxon@universeodon.com
* https://repository.essex.ac.uk/43578/ - Elite paper 2 from @markmoxon@universeodon.com

#security, #research
